$comment: Graphics presets, the calibration's shots and its cost attribution (capability-settings; ARCHITECTURE 24, frontend-ux 9.3-9.6; read by src/bench/table.ts). A preset is an internal pixel cap plus every declared setting at the preset's own level; the class hint seeds the preset before a calibration has run. Timings of the reference GPU are in docs/handoff/capability-settings.md.

attribution.$comment: Which GPU passes (attribution mode: <featureId>.<pass>) a setting's cost is taken from. A setting not listed takes the passes of the feature that declares it, less those another rule claims; whatever no setting claims is fixed cost, scaled with the internal pixels by fixedExponent. Passes of the lab ballast are never counted.
